speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment having regard to a recent anti-waste social experiment by NEA that seemed to generate more waste whilst raising awareness (a) whether the use of existing waste materials will be prioritised over creating new ones for future campaigns; (b) whether there are plans to seek input and involvement from local environmental organisations and advocates in planning future campaigns; and (c) whether the Ministry will consider sharing lessons from public reactions in shaping future sustainability awareness and as part of its public education efforts.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Will the Ministry consider using technology and digital displays instead of physical waste to showcase excessive consumption and not use methods such as providing free items to generate additional waste for future campaigns?

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: Some are also repurposed as craft for children.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: But as I have also noted, we hear and note the differing views of some and the suggestions that have been given, and we certainly will take their feedback including the Member's views and suggestions into consideration in our future campaigns.
